Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend holidays that occur in Canada in 2023**.  
For each entry I’ve included:

| Long‑Weekend Dates | Holiday (Observed) | Notes |
|--------------------|--------------------|-------|
| **Jan 1 – 3** | New Year’s Day (observed Mon Jan 2) | New Year’s Day falls on Sunday; the following Monday is the statutory day off. |
| **Feb 18 – 20** | Family Day (Ontario, BC, AB, SK, NB, PE) | Third Monday in February. Creates a Friday‑to‑Monday long weekend. |
| **Apr 7 – 9** | Good Friday (all provinces) | Friday before Easter. The following Sunday is a non‑working day, giving a 3‑day weekend. |
| **May 20 – 22** | Victoria Day (all provinces) | Monday before May 25. |
| **Jul 1 – 3** | Canada Day (all provinces) | July 1 falls on Saturday; the following Monday (Jul 3) is the statutory day off. |
| **Sep 2 – 4** | Labour Day (all provinces) | First Monday in September. |
| **Oct 7 – 9** | Thanksgiving (all provinces) | Second Monday in October. |
| **Nov 11 – 13** | Remembrance Day (all provinces) | Nov 11 falls on Saturday; the following Monday (Nov 13) is the statutory day off. |
| **Dec 23 – 25** | Christmas Day (all provinces) | Christmas falls on Monday; the preceding Friday (Dec 23) is a long‑weekend start. |

> **Provinces with additional long‑weekend holidays**  
> Some provinces have holidays that create extra long weekends in 2023. For example:  
> • **St. Patrick’s Day** (NL) – observed on Monday, Mar 20 (long weekend Mar 18‑20).  
> • **St. George’s Day** (PE) – observed on Monday, Apr 17 (long weekend Apr 15‑17).  
> • **St. John’s Day** (NL) – observed on Monday, Jun 12 (long weekend Jun 10‑12).  
> • **St. Patrick’s Day** (BC) – observed on Monday, Mar 20 (long weekend Mar 18‑20).

> • **St. John’s Day** (NL) – observed on Monday, Jun 12 (long weekend Jun 10‑12).
